svg.title: Five layers of the approach, and the ledger beside every one
svg.text: Five layers, and the ledger beside every one.
Whatever a layer does is an event on the ledger first; the rest is rebuilt from it.
the CBOM, the register and plan, changes, answers, gaps
rules over the evidence; the verifier is probes, no model
the app, the runner, the signer, the scanners: one job each
three tiers, each measured against a floor first
any host with Docker; images by digest, nothing fetched
